summary: A friend files for the same seat: {friend} has filed for the seat you are running for.
realLife: In 1986 he ran for an open Atlanta congressional seat against Julian Bond, a friend from the civil rights movement. In the runoff he challenged Bond to a drug test and his ads accused Bond of corruption; Lewis won 52 to 48.
choices: propose that neither of you goes negative

branches.when: your manager brings an attack ad on {friend}
branches.then: Run it, cut it down to what the record holds, or refuse it. A charge beyond the record is marked as a lie.
{friend} leads the first round, and the community's leaders pick sides.
Whoever loses makes a cold concession call. Years later one of you reaches out.
